description: Recordings download as bytes, and type the accessibility refusal. Observed live 2026-11-04 (daemon on Daytona Cloud v0.229.2): GET /computeruse/recordings/{id}/download answers `video/mp4` bytes, which the spec types as a JSON document; POST /computeruse/a11y/node/focus and /a11y/node/value on a node without that capability answer 400 "bad request: action not supported by node[: node has no EditableText ...]".

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The accessibility node doesn't support the action: it can't take focus, or has no editable text or numeric value (HTTP 400).
